one_line: machine-learning classifier for chemically modified siRNA silencing activity
skills: feature-weight interpretation against medicinal chemistry literature
data: siRNAmod database (chemically modified siRNAs with reported inhibition)
hand-assembled validation set extracted from primary literature not in siRNAmod (PubMed IDs listed in the Supplementary Information)

decisions.chose: training three model families side by side (random forest, MLP, linear SVM)
decisions.over: tuning one architecture as far as it would go
decisions.because: on a task nobody had modelled before, which family of approach suits the data is itself the finding
decisions.evidence: rather than attempting to optimize a single model architecture

decisions.chose: ROC AUC and precision-recall AUC as the ranking metrics
decisions.because: the classes are not balanced at any threshold, and a falsely optimistic call is the expensive mistake in drug development
decisions.evidence: ROC AUC was preferred over accuracy

decisions.chose: repeating the whole experiment at 60%, 70% and 80% inhibition cutoffs
decisions.over: a single cutoff, and over a stricter one
decisions.because: published definitions of an effective siRNA disagree, and a stricter cutoff leaves too few positives to learn from
decisions.evidence: Classifying siRNAs based on a higher threshold would not yield predictive models

decisions.chose: one-hot encoding base identity and modification at each position on both strands
decisions.over: encoding the chemical structure of each modification with cheminformatics descriptors
decisions.because: the categorical encoding was enough for a proof of concept, at the cost that a genuinely new modification chemistry cannot be scored without retraining
decisions.evidence: such a featurization method satisfies the purpose of this proof-of-concept study

decisions.chose: shrinking the MLP's hidden layers below the scikit-learn default
decisions.over: leaving the default width in place
decisions.because: the dataset is small enough that the default capacity was not warranted
decisions.evidence: decreased from the default value of 100

broke.what: the validation sequences the methods section pointed to were missing from the Supplementary Information at first submission, and a reviewer caught it
broke.evidence: The validation set sequences mentioned in Section 2.1 were not found in the Supplementary Information

broke.what: the supplementary spreadsheet still carried an earlier set of activity cutoffs that contradicted the ones in the manuscript; a reviewer spotted the mismatch and the file was corrected
broke.evidence: The thresholds in the supplementary data are inconsistent with the values stated in the article

broke.what: interpreting the learned weights turned out to need knowledge of how the modifications co-occur, because a high weight on one stabilising modification partly stands in for the other stabilising modifications that usually travel with it
broke.evidence: familiarity with the data and its limitations is a prerequisite for the effective interpretation of assigned weights

question: Can a model predict how well a chemically modified siRNA silences its target from base sequence and modification pattern alone?
rejected_line: Ran the classifiers at a 90 percent inhibition cutoff too; dropped it because so few sequences clear that bar the classes go too lopsided to learn from.
